targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('1 hour', "time") AS "time",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology IN ('Hydro Run-of-river and poundage','Hydro Water Reservoir')) AS "Hydro",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Biomass') AS "Biomass",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Nuclear') AS "Nuclear",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Fossil Brown coal/Lignite') AS "Lignite",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Fossil Hard coal') AS "Hard coal",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology IN ('Fossil Gas','Fossil Coal-derived gas')) AS "Fossil gas",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Fossil Oil') AS "Oil",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology IN ('Fossil Coal-derived gas','Fossil Oil shale','Waste','Other','Fossil Peat')) AS "Other fossil",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Wind Onshore') AS "Wind Onshore",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Wind Offshore') AS "Wind Offshore",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Solar') AS "Solar",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology IN ('Other renewable','Geothermal','Marine')) AS "Other VRE",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Hydro Pumped Storage' AND "Generation [MW]" > 0) AS "Storage discharge",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Hydro Pumped Storage' AND "Generation [MW]" <= 0) AS "Storage charge"
FROM cosema.per_type_gen
WHERE country = '$country' AND $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', "time") AS "time", SUM("Demand [MW]") AS "Actual demand"
FROM cosema.demand WHERE country = '$country' AND $__timeFilter("time") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', "time") AS "time", SUM("Demand [MW]") AS "Forecasted demand"
FROM cosema.demand_forecast WHERE country = '$country' AND $__timeFilter("time") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', "time") AS "time", SUM("Flow [MW]") AS "Flow from $country"
FROM cosema.cross_border_flow WHERE "from" = '$country' AND $__timeFilter("time") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', "time") AS "time", SUM("Flow [MW]") AS "Flow into $country"
FROM cosema.cross_border_flow WHERE "to" = '$country' AND $__timeFilter("time") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('1 hour', "time") AS "time",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Solar') AS "Total Solar DE (ERA5)",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Wind Onshore') AS "Total Wind Onshore DE (ERA5)"
FROM cosema.vre_gen
WHERE $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  time_bucket('1 hour', "time") AS "time",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Solar') AS "Total Solar $country (ENTSO-E)",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Wind Onshore') AS "Total Wind Onshore $country (ENTSO-E)"
FROM cosema.per_type_gen
WHERE country = '$country' AND $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  time_bucket('1 hour', "time") AS "time",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Solar') AS "Solar $state",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Wind Onshore') AS "Wind Onshore $state"
FROM cosema.vre_forecast
WHERE state = '$state' AND $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  time_bucket('1 hour', "time") AS "time",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Solar') AS "Total Solar (meteo)",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Wind Onshore') AS "Total Wind Onshore (meteo)"
FROM cosema.vre_forecast
WHERE $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  time_bucket('1 hour', "time") AS "time",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Solar') AS "Total Solar (ENTSO-E)",
  SUM("Generation [MW]") FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Wind Onshore') AS "Total Wind Onshore (ENTSO-E)"
FROM cosema.per_type_gen_forecast
WHERE country = 'DE' AND $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
